lines.en: I lurch forward on my toes.

lines.zh: 我的腿一软一硬，跑得歪。
lines.en: My legs go limp then stiff; I run crooked.
I shove down whatever blocks me.
My jaw hangs loose and won't close.

lines.zh: 我从废墟的缝里挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze through a gap in the ruins.
I run like I'm falling, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 我身上那件衣服已经很旧。
lines.en: These clothes of mine are very old.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌磨破了，还在跑。
lines.en: My soles are worn through, and I keep running.
I run straight down the road.
Limping, I still go on.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊甩得很不自然。
lines.en: My arms swing unnaturally.
I reach ahead with both hands.
I stand with my head cocked.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里有声音，说不成句。
lines.en: There's a sound in my throat, not words.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己原来是谁。
lines.en: I don't remember who I was.
I'm listening for people.
My fingers keep twitching.
A faint warmth drifts out of the alley mouth.
Until I fall, I keep walking.
I'm cold. No warmth left.
I look up. The sky is grey.
I stand askew, legs trembling.
You're warm.
I'm staring at your neck.
You back away; I come on.
I know that look in your eye.
Your hands are shaking.
One bite is enough.
Don't run. You won't get away.
I used to stand like that too.
Your armor won't stop teeth.
I close in, step by step.
I stagger back a step.
A piece is gone from my side, and no blood comes.
I rasp and keep walking.
My shin is folded; I switch to crawling.

lines.zh: 单膝跪地，手掌撑了一下。
lines.en: One knee hits the ground; my palm braces once.
I don't feel pain.
My arm has gone slack.
I still have to walk.
You knocked me crooked.
I'll keep chasing.
Is that food?
I lean toward it.
I want that.
You hold it up; I reach.
Not enough.
I'll bite your hand.
Food won't buy your life.
It smells good.
Drop it.
I'm not picky.
You hit me and I lurch.
I don't yield; I press in.
I grab your clothes.
You push me off; I come back.

lines.zh: 我的身体很轻，可很执拗。
lines.en: I'm light, but stubborn.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟碾过我的脚背。
lines.en: Your heel grinds across the top of my foot.
I hit the wall and keep going.
That knock is nothing.
I shove past you.
I stay against you and don't let go.
Another one walks the street too.
We sniff each other.
It's missing half an arm.

lines.zh: 我们一起往声音那边走。
lines.en: We head toward the sound together.
Our kind don't share food.

lines.zh: 它咬了我一口，我不在乎。
lines.en: It bit me. I don't care.
We walk, one behind the other.
It fell. I didn't stop.
There are many of us on the street.
We walk until we drop.
I grab it and shove it in my mouth.
I pick up what's on the ground.
I carry it with my hand hanging low.
The pearl is hard on my teeth.
I want all of it.
My grip fails and it drops.
I smother it under my chest.
I drop it and lower my head to search again.
I stuff it into a torn pocket.
My hands won't obey; picking things up is hard.
You're there.
I smell blood.
I quicken my pace.
I reach out ahead.
Your scent is strong.
I've fixed on your direction.
A sound rises in my throat.
You run; I follow.
Even dragging a leg, I catch you.
I bite the sleeve first, then bite deeper.
Only us on this street.
I lean forward, one foot already off the ground.
I hear your breathing.
You won't leave this alley.
I'm moving.
You turned into the alley.
I keep following.
The glass you stepped on rang out.
I lurch over the low wall.
You change course; I turn with you.
My footsteps are ragged.
You're behind the car.
I wait for you to come out.
You're slowing.

lines.zh: 我停不下来，我会一直走。
lines.en: I can't stop. I keep walking.
Your shadow is still ahead of me.
I haven't left you once.
You've backed into a dead end.
A little closer.
You smell of blood now.
I hear you gasping.
I know this road.
You have a few steps left.
I lunge and bite your arm.
My teeth jam in your armor's seam.
This bite won't stop bleeding.

lines.zh: 指甲划过去，只刮到衣角。
lines.en: My nails rake past and catch only the hem of your coat.

lines.zh: 我的指甲抓进你的袖子。
lines.en: My nails sink into your sleeve.
My weight staggers you.
I bite your calf.
Now you can't run.
I rasp in my throat.
You back off; I lunge again.
I bite down on your shoulder.
That wound will fester a long while.
I slam into your chest.

lines.zh: 你护住了一边，另一边空了。
lines.en: You guard one side; the other is open.
My teeth sink in and tear off a strip of cloth.
There's blood on my teeth.
I push up out of the rubble.
One more shadow on the street.
I steady myself, crooked.
I don't remember how I died.
The first sound leaves my throat.
There's still the smell of the living here.
I come out of the alley mouth.

lines.zh: 土从肩头一块块滑下去。
lines.en: Clods of earth slide off my shoulders one by one.
My fingers begin to move.
I think I've been here before.
I step into the light.
Dust falls from my clothes.
My jaw clicks once.
I raise my head toward the sound.
Fire shrinks my skin.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的骨头响了一下。
lines.en: I fall and my bones knock.
Water fills my lungs; I keep walking.
The blast tears off a whole leg.
An arrow sinks into my chest.
Light burns along my nerves.
I've been hungry this whole time.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整个人一抽。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my whole body jerks.
I fall, arms still reaching.
